note: Tweak catalog (P4-02). Each row is a named place where a mod can change a value. game.tweaks.on(name, fn) installs the hook and passes { value, instance, args } to fn, and fn returns the new value. Docs and stubs are generated from this file.

tweaks.name: pawn.hunger_rate
tweaks.doc: How fast a pawn's food need falls each tick.

tweaks.name: pawn.rest_fall_rate
tweaks.doc: How fast a pawn's rest need falls each tick.

tweaks.name: pawn.joy_fall_rate
tweaks.doc: How fast a pawn's recreation need falls per need interval.

tweaks.name: pawn.carry_capacity
tweaks.doc: How much mass a pawn can carry. args[1] is the pawn.

tweaks.name: plant.growth_rate
tweaks.doc: How fast a plant grows. instance is the plant.

tweaks.name: thing.max_hit_points
tweaks.doc: The most hit points a thing can have. Called very often.

tweaks.name: thing.market_value
tweaks.doc: What a thing is worth, which feeds wealth, raids and trade.

tweaks.name: time.rate_multiplier
tweaks.doc: How fast the game runs for the current speed setting.

tweaks.name: shot.hit_factor_shooter
tweaks.doc: The part of a shot's hit chance that comes from the shooter's skill. args[1] is the shooter.

tweaks.name: health.bleed_rate
tweaks.doc: How fast a pawn bleeds in total.

tweaks.name: social.opinion
tweaks.doc: What one pawn thinks of another, from -100 to 100. args[1] is the other pawn.

tweaks.name: power.plant_output
tweaks.doc: The power a generator wants to produce.
